name: learning-study-2026-10-15
family_selection: highest equal-weight mean selected validation return across all three seeds; deterministic ties use family name then lower reward scale
stopping: Stop after the first completed stage satisfying the declared validation gate, exhausted four-stage protocol, budget/deadline/metering stop or user interruption. No automatic restart after budget stop.
retired_test: 2024-01-02 through 2026-09-30 has already been inspected; no new test evaluation or tuning against its results
controls: Same 26 tradables, dates, training-only normalization, simulator costs, action contract and net-log-equity objective. Scale variants change only the learning reward multiplier; always evaluate real net equity.
logging: Compact JSONL every 10000 transitions; explicit post-update milestones supersede same-step on-step records in CSV/HTML; track current, best, percentage-point increments, gain since 50k and buy-hold excess.
